{{Top|leg}}
The '''Revos Liberty''' was a hostel that catered to crews on shore leave on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

During [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to Storinal, [[Yokel Group]] found lodgings there.<ref name="WS" />
